Roof Plumbing & Re-Roofing in St Kilda

Sandhurst Roofing is a family owned roofing business with more than 30 years of experience looking after homes right across St Kilda. From re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel and roof plumbing to guttering and tile to tin conversions, we back every job with honest advice and quality workmanship.

St Kilda is full of period homes and apartment buildings, and we take the time to do the work in a way that suits the building. Call Steve on 0448 812 800 for a free, no-obligation quote.

Get a Free Quote!

Roofs in St Kilda: What We Commonly See

St Kilda has some of Melbourne's most distinctive housing, from grand Victorian and Edwardian homes and terraces to Art Deco apartment blocks, much of it under heritage overlays. Roofs here range from slate to metal, often with parapet walls and box gutters that need careful attention.

Being inner-bayside, St Kilda gets salt in the air, and its older roofs face the usual wear of age: worn flashings and leaks where parapet flashings or box gutters have failed. On period buildings and apartments, blocked or undersized box gutters are a common cause of internal leaks. Working sympathetically with the original building matters here.

Re-Roofing & Roof Replacement in St Kilda

When a roof on a period building has reached the end of its life, replacing it carefully is the smarter long-term spend. We re-roof St Kilda homes and buildings in COLORBOND® steel, which is light, durable and well suited to bayside weather, in profiles and colours that sit well with the building.

Thinking about going metal? We also handle tile to tin conversions, swapping a heavy, high-maintenance roof for lightweight metal. If your roof has widespread leaks, sagging or badly rusted sheeting, talk to us about a re-roof before you keep paying for patch jobs. We will give you a straight answer on what makes the most sense for your home and budget.

Roof Plumbing & Guttering in St Kilda

Our registered roof plumbers are experienced with the box gutters, parapet flashings and valleys that older buildings depend on. On period homes and apartments a blocked or undersized box gutter is a common cause of internal leaks, and we deal with the cause rather than the stain.

Whether you need one section of guttering replaced or a full re-gutter with matching downpipes in COLORBOND® steel, we will quote it clearly and finish it neatly. Small jobs such as gutter repairs are no problem either.

What Affects the Cost of Roofing in St Kilda

Your quote depends on what your roof actually needs. Roof size, pitch and access, the type of steel and colour you choose, and how much plumbing work is involved are the main factors. We give you a clear written quote after an on-site inspection, so you know what you are paying for before any work starts.

Our St Kilda Roofing Process

It starts with a free on-site inspection and a written quote. Once you approve it we strip the existing roof, check and prepare the framing, then install new COLORBOND® steel sheeting, flashings and ridge capping, along with new guttering and downpipes where they are part of the job. Every job finishes with a clean site.

Why St Kilda Locals Choose Sandhurst Roofing

St Kilda locals choose Sandhurst Roofing because we turn up when we say we will, do quality work and charge a fair price. We are fully licensed and insured, with registered roof plumbers on the team, and we explain what is happening every step of the way. Have a look at the COLORBOND® colour chart to start choosing your colour.

St Kilda Roofing FAQs

Can you work on heritage and period buildings?

Yes. We are used to older buildings, including box gutters and parapet flashings, and we take care to work in a way that suits the building.

Can you fix blocked or leaking box gutters?

Yes. We clear, reline and replace box gutters, and make sure the overflow points and downpipes are working correctly.

Do you offer free quotes?

Yes, every quote is free and without obligation. Call Steve on 0448 812 800.

Suburbs We Service Near St Kilda

We also work on roofs elsewhere across bayside Melbourne, including Hampton, Black Rock, Beaumaris and Highett.
